rationale: Colin's expertise in developer relations, ecosystem building, and AI infrastructure tooling complements Theresa's mission to democratize access to social-impact work through AI-powered platforms. While Colin focuses on GPU cloud infrastructure and multi-agent systems for builders, Theresa is leveraging similar AI tools to make civic-tech recruitment more accessible—they're both using technology to remove barriers in their respective communities, and Colin's mentorship background in developer strategy and ecosystem growth could directly inform how RemotelyGood scales adoption among both job seekers and employers.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Theresa — you're both building community-first platforms powered by AI infrastructure, and Colin's 20 years in developer relations and ecosystem building could offer valuable perspective as Theresa scales RemotelyGood's employer adoption and user engagement.
